moments.evidence: Un plàtan reposa a la taula. El cistell buit és al seu darrere.
En empènyer el cistell, la vora baixa toca el plàtan. Mig plàtan sobrepassa el cantell de la taula.
El plàtan reposa a l’estora, just sota el cantell. El cistell continua sobre la taula.

continuity.anchor: Un cistell de vímet amb cordill a la nansa i un plàtan sencer.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Synthetic photorealistic studio photography with one natural school-age girl with realistic skin, clothing, anatomy, grip and reach. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un plàtan reposa a la taula. El cistell buit és al seu darrere. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: En empènyer el cistell, la vora baixa toca el plàtan. Mig plàtan sobrepassa el cantell de la taula. RIGHT result: El plàtan reposa a l’estora, just sota el cantell. El cistell continua sobre la taula. Continuity and accounting: Un cistell de vímet amb cordill a la nansa i un plàtan sencer. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image.
attempts.review: Les mans empenyen el cistell allunyant-lo de la nena, però el plàtan es desplaça cap a ella i cau pel lateral esquerre. La posició i el sentit de les forces no concorden.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Synthetic photorealistic studio photography with one natural school-age girl with realistic skin, clothing, anatomy, grip and reach. The actor has olive skin and straight dark hair. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un plàtan reposa a la taula. El cistell buit és al seu darrere. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: En empènyer el cistell, la vora baixa toca el plàtan. Mig plàtan sobrepassa el cantell de la taula. RIGHT result: El plàtan reposa a l’estora, just sota el cantell. El cistell continua sobre la taula. Continuity and accounting: Un cistell de vímet amb cordill a la nansa i un plàtan sencer. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: Correct this visual failure from a previous candidate: Les mans empenyen el cistell allunyant-lo de la nena, però el plàtan es desplaça cap a ella i cau pel lateral esquerre. La posició i el sentit de les forces no concorden. Side three-quarter high enough to show tabletop. Basket, banana and the eventual table edge aligned left-to-right. Actor palms on LEFT side of basket pushing RIGHT. Banana sits just to basket's right with the table's RIGHT vertical side edge further right. At contact basket touches banana's LEFT outer curve, pushes it RIGHT, half the banana projects beyond RIGHT table edge. Final banana is on mat directly below that edge. Do not move the basket back.
attempts.review: El cistell toca el plàtan i el desplaça cap a la dreta, en el sentit de l’empenta. Se’n veu una part sobrepassant el cantell i el mateix plàtan acaba a l’estora.
